resources.string: By RovianDev. Makes browser dialogs respond with overlays present. Reduces tapjacking protection in selected browsers.

Version 1.0.0 · by RovianDev

Allow browser dialogs to respond while trusted overlays such as Panels are running.

Setup
Enable this module in LSPosed, select only the browsers that need it, then force-stop those browsers and reopen them or reboot. Manage scope in LSPosed.

Browser scope
Opera, Opera beta, Chrome, Brave, Edge, Samsung Browser, Firefox, Vivaldi and DuckDuckGo.

Testing
The underlying fix was confirmed working with Panels in Opera. The expanded release and other browsers still need device testing.

Security tradeoff
The module makes touches appear unobscured inside selected browsers, for all overlays, not only Panels. This reduces tapjacking protection throughout those browsers. Enable only where needed and use trusted overlays.

Permissions
You still choose Allow or Deny. Android permission-controller dialogs and system input blocking are unchanged. No analytics or network permission.
